facts.fact: The interior ministry's deck states that communes and their annexes issue birth, marriage and death acts in under a minute from any commune or annex in the country, and its architecture slide shows entry, checking and updating at commune level in 1,541 commune databases linked to a national database at the ministry; no date is given, so the presentation's date is used.

The interior ministry's architecture slide shows the commune, wilaya and ministry levels of the civil-status register linked over the ministry's own network, labelled 'Réseau MICL'; no date is given, so the presentation's date is used.

The interior ministry's architecture slide numbers the communes on the civil-status network C1 to C1541 with 1,541 commune databases, and the deck speaks of 'the 1541 communes' and of issue from any commune in the national territory: 1,541 of 1,541 communes on the ministry's own account, with no rural figure; no date is given, so the presentation's date is used.

The network linking communes and wilayas to the national civil-status database is shown as the interior ministry's own ('Réseau MICL'), with the national database held at ministry level; no date is given, so the presentation's date is used.
A slide footed 22 October 2017 states that communes use the applications of the biometric identity card, reading and updating them, over an 'INTRANET'; the slide's own date is used.
